title: No head-to-head tool between two named teams
evidence: server.go:25-32 defines 5 tools (search_matches, team_stats, player_search, competition_stats, standings); none accepts two team names. search_matches (server.go:27, soccer.go:144) and team_stats (server.go:28, soccer.go:234) each take a single `team`, so head-to-head W/L/D between two clubs cannot be requested. R11 how_to_verify unmet.
suggestion: Add a head_to_head tool taking team_a and team_b that filters matches to those two clubs and reports each side's W/L/D + goals.

title: Datasets loaded without dedup/normalization — Brasileirao 2019 double-counted in team_stats & competition_stats
evidence: soccer.go:34-41 loads Brasileirao_Matches.csv as 'Brasileirão' and soccer.go:45 loadHistorical loads novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv also as 'Brasileirão'; both independently hold 380 rows for season=2019 (38 Flamengo matches each, verified). Stats() (soccer.go:234-268) and Average() (soccer.go:288-301) match by normalized substring, so team_stats('Flamengo',2019) sums both files -> 76 played (W56) and competition_stats(2019) -> 760 matches instead of 380. No dedup on (season,date,home,away).
suggestion: Deduplicate matches on (season, date±1d, home, away) after normalizing team names, or scope Brasileirão aggregation to one canonical source file.

title: standings() keys on raw team name, so name variants split/duplicate rows and Botafogo-RJ doubles
evidence: soccer.go:186/190 do table[m.Home]/table[m.Away] on the RAW name; norm() (soccer.go:141) only strips -SP/-RJ and is not applied to the standings key. Across the two Brasileirão files the same club appears under different raw strings ('Flamengo-RJ' vs 'Flamengo', 'Atletico-MG' vs 'Atlético-MG'), producing ~39 rows for 2019 with each club listed twice; 'Botafogo-RJ' is byte-identical in both files so it merges and doubles to 76 played. The standings capability itself is present and computed from matches (R9 satisfied), but the table is corrupted on the real dataset.
suggestion: Key the standings map on a fully-normalized team name (fold accents, strip all -UF suffixes) after deduping matches.

title: First-evaluator R9 'missing' claim is incorrect — standings IS implemented
evidence: Standings() (soccer.go:179-232) computes points/GD/goals from matches and orders the table; exercised by TestPlayersAndAverage (soccer_test.go:34-37). The '19 of 20 clubs' in _factual.json is a factual_accuracy artifact: the Go server emits single-line JSON (jsonResult, soccer.go:304-306), so the harness's line-based _atletico_rows count (factual_accuracy.py:106-107) sees both Atléticos on one line and reports 1 of 2. All 20 club tokens are present. R9 -> implemented for requirement_coverage.
suggestion: None — recorded to correct the prior evaluation.
